## Frame-local loss models (own-mesh rollouts; `frames` step)

prod = mean_f g(e_sim-ref) * g(e_ref-truth); quad = mean_f g(sqrt(e_s^2 + e_r^2)); sum = mean_f g(e_s + e_r); g = the kit per-frame AUC share. cov = mean(gs*gr) - mean(gs)*mean(gr).

rest / moved = the part of T - prod from object-frames where the true object is at its frame-0 pose (1.5 cm, 5 deg) / elsewhere; sim>ref = mean max(g(e_t) - g(e_r), 0).
